Messages.Author: legb...@my-dejanews.com
Messages.Body:
This has happened in jol95, which i moderate, and i'd like a ruling, please.

Sylvester Simms calls a Praxis Seizure: Cairo. Suhailah is already in play,
but the vote passes.

Clearly Sylvester does not become Prince until/unless Suhailah yields, but is
he still a Primogen whilst contesting the other title?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
legb...@my-dejanews.com wrote:
> This has happened in jol95, which i moderate, and i'd like a ruling, please.
>
> Sylvester Simms calls a Praxis Seizure: Cairo. Suhailah is already in play,
> but the vote passes.
>
> Clearly Sylvester does not become Prince until/unless Suhailah yields, but is
> he still a Primogen whilst contesting the other title?

He lost the Primogen title when the Praxis passed.

He became a Prince when the vote passed (and immediately began contesting
that title).
